title: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
description:
Clinical Negligence Paralegal

Location: Liverpool

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 + bonus

Working pattern: Hybrid working

The Opportunity

An opportunity has arisen for a Clinical Negligence Paralegal to join a growing clinical negligence team based in Liverpool.

This role would suit a Junior Clinical Negligence Paralegal, an experienced Paralegal looking for their next step, or an NQ Solicitor with previous paralegal experience in clinical negligence.

You will join an established team handling a range of clinical negligence matters, with the opportunity to take ownership of your own caseload and develop your fee-earning experience in a supportive environment.

The Role
- Manage your own caseload of clinical negligence matters from instruction through to resolution.
- Assist clients throughout the claims process, providing clear communication and regular updates.
- Investigate potential claims, reviewing medical records and gathering relevant evidence.
- Liaise with medical experts, counsel, clients and other parties involved in proceedings.
- Draft legal documents, correspondence and other case-related documentation.
- Monitor case progress, deadlines and key milestones to ensure matters are progressed efficiently.
- Contribute to the continued development of the clinical negligence team.

About You
- Previous experience handling clinical negligence matters within a law firm.
- Experience managing or assisting with a clinical negligence caseload.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a client-focused approach.
- A proactive attitude and the confidence to take responsibility for your own matters.
- A genuine interest in developing your career within clinical negligence.

Applications are welcome from experienced paralegals at different stages of their careers, including Senior Paralegals and NQ Solicitors with relevant paralegal experience.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 - £35,000, depending on experience.
- Bonus potential.
- Hybrid working, typically three days in the office one week and two days the following week.
- Flexibility around the working arrangement for the right candidate.
- The opportunity to manage your own fee-earning caseload.
- The chance to develop your expertise within a dedicated clinical negligence team.
- A supportive environment with scope for continued professional development.

If you're looking for your next opportunity in clinical negligence and want to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
description:
Clinical Negligence Paralegal / 1+ Years' Experience / Merseyside / c£28,000 / An excellent opportunity for a Clinical Negligence Paralegal to join an established and supportive team, assisting with a varied caseload of clinical negligence claims while developing your legal experience and playing an important role in supporting clients through the claims process - To apply please call Teagan on and quote Job Ref: 6089

JOB TITLE: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
PQE REQUIRED: 1+
LOCATION: Merseyside
SALARY: Up to £28,000 (DOE)

THE ROLE:
You will join an experienced medical negligence team, working alongside other Paralegals and Solicitors to support claims from initial enquiry through to investigation.
A key part of the role will involve handling new enquiries, carrying out initial investigations into potential claims and acting as an early point of contact for clients. You will discuss funding options, prepare risk assessments, obtain and review medical records, draft witness statements and assist with instructing medical experts.
You will also manage your own caseload of new enquiry claims, undertake legal and quantum research, prepare correspondence and court documentation and support Solicitors with the progression of their wider caseloads. Regular liaison with clients, medical experts and third parties will be an important part of the position, alongside keeping track of appointments, deadlines and case progression.

THE CANDIDATE:
The successful candidate will have previous Paralegal experience, ideally with at least 1 years' experience within clinical negligence. You should have a good understanding of the claims process and be confident dealing with clients, reviewing documentation and assisting with the preparation of legal cases.
You will be highly organised, with strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. A professional and empathetic approach to client care is essential, alongside a proactive attitude and genuine enthusiasm for developing your legal knowledge and experience.

THE FIRM:
You will be joining an established law firm that places real importance on teamwork, support, guidance and continued learning. The firm promotes a collaborative working environment where colleagues are encouraged to share knowledge, develop their skills and contribute to the success of the wider practice.
The role offers 20 days' annual leave, increasing to 25 days after five years' service, plus bank holidays and three additional days over the Christmas closure period.
Additional benefits include hybrid working after probation, birthday leave, paid sick leave, dependant's leave, Medicash healthcare scheme, discounts on legal services, employer supported volunteering, wellbeing and social events, bonus and recognition schemes and regular performance and salary reviews.

HOW TO APPLY:
Contact Teagan Portas at eNL on / or email with your CV, or simply call for a confidential discussion.

eNL will never share your CV with a third party without your express permission. As part of our candidate care process, we aim to respond to all applications in 7 days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale, your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please note our advertisements use PQE/salary levels purely as a guide.

At eNL we value diversity and inclusion. We want to attract people at all levels and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates whatever your ethnicity, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any characteristics protected by law in the jurisdictions in which we operate.

title: Housing Disrepair Paralegal
description:
Housing Disrepair Paralegal

Progressive Civil Litigation specialist practice operating out of central Liverpool has a very exciting opening for an ambitious Paralegal to join its established Housing Disrepair team.

The position will see you focusing on a Housing Disrepair caseload from introduction of the claims right through to settlement. You'll be a confident Paralegal, experienced in handling your own caseload from instruction to settlement and also assist the senior team on complex litigated matters.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Paralegal to join a renowned, growing Housing Disrepair team at an exciting stage of its development. The reward for your role will be a competitive salary (in line with your previous experience) along with full company benefits.

title: Housing Disrepair Paralegal
description:
Housing Disrepair Paralegal

Location: Liverpool City Centre

Salary: £25,800

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Working Pattern: Office-based during training, moving to a hybrid working model upon successful completion of probation and training.

About the Company

Our client is a rapidly growing law firm based in the heart of Liverpool City Centre, specialising in claimant litigation and housing disrepair claims. Due to continued expansion and an increasing caseload, they are seeking a proactive and organised Housing Disrepair Paralegal to join their successful legal team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Paralegal looking to develop their career within a supportive and progressive environment, with genuine opportunities for advancement.

The Role

As a Housing Disrepair Paralegal, you will support Solicitors and Fee Earners in managing a caseload of housing disrepair matters on behalf of tenants living in social and private rented accommodation. You will play a key role in progressing cases efficiently while ensuring an excellent client experience throughout the claims process.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with the management of a caseload of housing disrepair claims.
- Conducting initial client assessments and obtaining relevant information and evidence.
- Preparing legal documentation, correspondence, witness statements and court bundles.
- Liaising with clients, landlords, housing associations, experts, surveyors and third parties.
- Requesting and reviewing medical and expert reports where required.
- Managing case files and ensuring compliance with court deadlines and internal procedures.
- Drafting letters of claim and other pre-action protocol documentation.
- Updating clients on case progress and responding to enquiries.
- Maintaining accurate records using the firm's case management system.
- Supporting solicitors through to settlement or litigation where necessary.

Candidate Requirements

Essential
- Law degree
- Strong administrative and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise effectively.
- High level of attention to detail.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Client-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills.

Desirable
- Previous experience handling Housing Disrepair claims.
- Experience within Civil Litigation, Personal Injury, Housing Law or Litigation departments.
- Law degree, LPC, SQE studies or equivalent legal qualification.
- Understanding of Pre-Action Protocols and Civil Procedure Rules.

Benefits
- Hybrid working following completion of training and probation.
- Modern Liverpool City Centre offices with excellent transport links.
- Clear progression and development opportunities.
- Ongoing training and mentoring.
- Supportive and collaborative team environment.
- Pension scheme.
- Annual leave increasing with service.
- Employee wellbeing initiatives.
- Regular social events and team-building activities.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be ambitious, organised and eager to build a long-term career within a growing litigation practice. You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, delivering exceptional client service while supporting the successful progression of housing disrepair claims.

To apply, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.

title: Legal Assistant - Court Team
description:
Bond Turner is a leading law firm, proudly recognised by both Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners. We are committed to ensuring access to justice for our clients and their families, providing expert legal services with a client-centered approach.

With offices in Liverpool and Bolton, we offer nationwide legal advice across a wide range of sectors.

Our areas of expertise include Credit Hire, Personal Injury, including Complex Injury, Clinical and Professional Negligence, Housing Disrepair, Group Action Claims and Public Inquiries. We understand that our growth as a business is driven by the success of our people. We take pride in fostering a positive, collaborative work environment where everyone can contribute to our shared success. With exceptional support at every turn, every employee is empowered to reach their full potential.

We're recruiting an experienced Pre-Litigation Legal Assistant to join our Court team in Liverpool. This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about delivering excellent client service and achieving strong results.

In this role, you'll manage a mixed caseload of injury and non-injury claims, reviewing and progressing files to assess settlement prospects or readiness for issue. You'll advise on the merits of personal injury and credit hire matters, provide clear updates to clients and work towards set targets.

This position is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of the Civil Procedure Rules, and while credit hire experience is desirable, it isn't essential. If you're driven, ambitious and looking for a stimulating role where you can continue to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

About You

- Excellent attention to detail
- Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills
- Highly organised with confident verbal communication
- Able to use initiative and apply logic in a fast-paced environment
- Comfortable working to strict deadlines and managing competing priorities

Company Values:

We're a collaboration of companies established in 2006 working towards and guaranteeing the same goal. Our mission: We are driven to succeed. Our purpose is to help people move on in their lives through supporting our clients, our communities and each other.

We offer a clean professional office working environment with fantastic facilities in the heart of Liverpool City Centre which has great travel links.

- Workplace pension scheme.

title: Property Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking an experienced Property Paralegal to join the property team of a respected regional law firm in Crosby, Merseyside. This full-time, permanent job offers the opportunity to support senior lawyers with residential conveyancing and commercial property matters in a busy friendly team. The benefits include hybrid working following successful completion of probation, 24 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, an additional day off for your birthday, Medicash and life assurance worth twice your salary. In addition, the firm offers a 4% employer pension contribution and ongoing professional development opportunities.Role Responsibilities

As a Property Paralegal, you will support senior property lawyers throughout the conveyancing process and help ensure clients receive a responsive service. Your key responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with residential and commercial conveyancing matters, including flats.
- Setting up files, supporting client onboarding and progressing transactions through completion and post-completion.
- Managing diaries, key dates and tasks on property files.
- Keeping clients informed of progress and responding to enquiries professionally.
- Liaising with estate agents, lenders and other third parties.
- Using case management systems, conveyancing portals and other digital tools to progress matters.
- Providing day-to-day assistance to property lawyers across the firm's offices.

Skills and Experience Required

The firm is seeking an organised and confident Property Paralegal with practical experience of supporting residential conveyancing matters. You should be able to demonstrate the following:
- At least 12 months' previous experience in a Property Paralegal position.
- Experience assisting with residential conveyancing transactions.
- Practical knowledge of case management systems, Laserforms, HM Land Registry and SDLT portals.
- Strong communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Good numerical skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise under pressure.
- Experience supporting commercial conveyancing matters would be advantageous.
- Knowledge of InfoTrack or experience in a CQS-accredited practice would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Benefits and Rewards

This opportunity combines varied property work with a package designed to support career development and wellbeing. The successful Property Paralegal will also benefit from:
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probation.
- 24 days annual leave plus bank holidays and an additional day off for your birthday.
- Employer pension contributions of 4%.
- Life assurance worth twice your salary.
- Medicash health cash plan.
- Paid time off for charitable activities.
- Ongoing training, professional development and clear opportunities for career progression.
- Discounted legal services for you and your family.

About the Law Firm

Our client is an established regional law firm with a strong presence across Merseyside, delivering a broad range of legal services to individuals and businesses. Its property team works collaboratively across its offices and is recognised for its emphasis on client service, staff development and a friendly working culture.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Property Paralegal job in Crosby, Merseyside, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.
